assertion.statement: The embedded cache metrics querier_cache_added_total, querier_cache_gets_total and querier_cache_misses_total are removed in Loki 3.0.0, replaced by loki_cache_fetched_keys, loki_cache_hits and loki_cache_request_duration_seconds.

proposal.undeterminedReason: subject: Prometheus metric names fit no subject family; the change covers three metrics.; applicability: Exposure depends on whether dashboards or alerts consume these metrics, which no configuration predicate expresses.; consequence: The evidence does not say what happens to consumers of the removed metrics.
